name: Agnes P. Gonzalez
office: Rowland Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Agnes P. Gonzalez is a member of the Rowland Unified School District Board of Education representing Trustee Area 1, appointed in 2021 and re-appointed in 2022. Her current term ends in December 2026. Before joining the board, she worked at Nogales High School from 1990 to 2020, supporting the school's fiscal and accounting operations. She also chairs the City of Walnut Senior Commission. She was named board clerk in 2022. As of 2025, she is the board president.
